[Backup plan] If results are poor, try relaxing entry filters to rsi < 40 or add a trend filter (e.g., 50-period MA). As an alternative, consider a volatility-based scaling approach or MACD + ATR breakout filter instead.

pre_reflection.text:
[Pre-reflection] The strategy's reliance on multiple filters may cause overfitting or reduced trade frequency, especially with strict ADX and RSI thresholds. The exit rule based on middle band crossover is simplistic and may lead to premature exits during strong trends. Bollinger bands' sensitivity to volatility can generate whipsaw signals in choppy markets.
[Backup plan] If performance is poor, reduce ADX threshold to 20 and allow RSI to drop to 45 for entries. If Sharpe is mediocre, widen bollinger bands to 2.2 std devs and add a minimum 3-bar confirmation for breakouts. As an alternative, consider a volatility-adjusted breakout with ATR-based position sizing and a trailing stop instead of fixed band exits.

pre_reflection.text:
[Pre-reflection] The strategy's reliance on RSI > 50 and ADX > 25 for entry may cause whipsaws in ranging markets; Bollinger crossover alone is prone to false signals. The exit rule based on bollinger.middle crossover is too simplistic and may lead to premature exits. No position sizing or dynamic stop-loss based on ATR is implemented, which could result in inconsistent risk management.
[Backup plan] If results are poor, switch to a dual-filter entry: close above BB.upper AND RSI > 50 AND ADX > 25 AND price > 20-period MA. If Sharpe is mediocre, optimize ADX threshold (try 20-30) and add ATR-based dynamic stop-loss. As alternative, try momentum-based entry with MACD + ATR filters for better trend confirmation.
